svg.aria-label: How the pieces fit: you write agent files, tools and schemas; the @theokit/sdk agent runtime executes them behind four safety gates and a kernel sandbox; entry points are the web UI, terminal UI, eleven messaging channels, your app, the typed client and webhooks; capabilities include auth, channels, database, workflows, evaluations, nine deploy targets and the MCP, ACP and A2A protocols.
